## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results, including checks you could not run. For UI changes, include a screenshot or short recording with public or synthetic data.

For provider, connector or notebook changes, distinguish local protocol fixtures from real external-service or kernel execution. Include relevant versions and prerequisites without credentials.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility, migration, permission or security implications when relevant.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed secrets, private research data and local credentials.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and tests for the behavior changed.
- [ ] I identified any unverified behavior or required external dependencies above.
